source_snapshot.test_name_items: Install OS from USB device with uEFI mode
source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    1. Power on system and boot from USB device to Install OS
2. Check system event log
3. Do a warm reboot
4. Check system event log
5. Do a cold reboot
6. Check system event log
7. Do an AC cycle
8. Check system event log
9. Repeat step 3 to step 8 for 3 times after installation completes

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1. Os Installation should be completed successfully
2. System should be workable after reboot
3. System event log should not have error/fail/warning messages (except the message is a known event. Consult with RD first.)

deepseek_columns.ai_commands: Operator installation/cycles plus incomplete uptime/dmesg/lspci evidence.

historical_reviews.deepseek: PARTIAL; correctly sees human/destructive core but incomplete storage, UEFI and per-cycle event coverage.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION / CHANGED; adds target-disk, backup, UEFI and cycle evidence gates.
historical_reviews.round_02: PARTIAL due USB installation and power actions.

original_test_intent: Install an approved OS from physical USB in UEFI mode to an explicitly selected disk, then prove usability and acceptable event logs after warm reboot, cold reboot and AC cycle repeated three times.
original_method: Identify/protect all storage and approve the exact overwrite target/media/UEFI policy, have an engineer perform USB boot/install and required physical power actions, and collect boot/device/event evidence after every warm, cold and AC action using the existing cycle scripts where applicable.
manual_activity: The core requires physical USB boot/interactive OS installation and AC-cycle operation. An engineer must select the disk and perform/observe those actions; the agent can prepare checks and automate post-install collection but cannot claim core completion.
required_inputs: Exact OS image/build and USB media hash/signature
UEFI/Secure Boot settings and installation recipe
Explicit safe target disk/volume plus backup/restore coverage
Warm/cold/AC definitions, three-repeat sequence and known-event/RD exception list
Console, OOB recovery, maintenance approval and final-state plan
safety_requirements: Never infer or write to a disk; reject mounted, active OS/EFI/swap, RAID/LVM/device-mapper or otherwise protected targets without explicit authorization.
Preserve logs and storage/device baselines before installation.
Human controls USB install and physical AC action; do not substitute reboot/BMC power for required AC cycle.
Stop on installer ambiguity, wrong boot mode, missing device, failed readiness or unexplained error/fail/warning.
No automatic retry of install or any cycle.
agent_execution_scope: Inventory storage/workloads, validate media/UEFI/target approval and prepare evidence/recovery gates.
After engineer actions, collect installed OS/UEFI/device/storage and per-cycle BMC/SEL/journal/dmesg evidence.
Compare known-event policy and report Tool Result without claiming installation/power action or verdict.
engineer_actions: Approve destructive target and perform USB boot/installation.
Perform required warm/cold/AC actions and intervene on failure.
Review every cycle/known-event exception and issue PASS/FAIL.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Its short error tail and PCIe count omit warnings, storage safety, UEFI proof, BMC/SEL and per-action evidence; operator cycle description is incomplete.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Preserve USB install and three-action sequence; use the referenced project cycle scripts only after validation and without replacing physical AC semantics.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: USB UEFI install, warm/cold/AC sequence, three repeats, event criteria, all three script URLs and 25/45-minute fields are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.status: HUMAN INSTALL/AC CORE WITH AUTOMATED EVIDENCE
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use immutable media/target identities and an installation transcript, then execute an indexed three-repeat warm/cold/AC ledger with readiness and full event delta after every action.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Dedicated SUTs with console, approved USB media and recoverable storage/power paths.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record OS image/hash, installer, BIOS/UEFI/BMC, cycle scripts and inventory-tool versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: OS/vendor installation guide and referenced approved project cycle scripts.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds storage protection, boot-mode proof and complete per-cycle trace without changing USB or power methods.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Target disk, known-event and recovery policies.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Automated unattended installation would be a project-specific method override, not proof of the source's physical USB workflow.

project_override_considerations: Projects may choose target disk, OS build, expected exceptions and cycle controls. Actual sequence/count must be reported; reduced or API-substituted actions cannot claim source coverage.
expected_evidence: Media hash, UEFI settings, safe target-disk identity, backups and approval
Engineer installation transcript and successful UEFI booted OS/build/device inventory
For each of three repeats: warm/cold/AC action, timestamps, readiness and console/power evidence
Per-action BMC/SEL/journal/dmesg with approved known-event dispositions
Final usability, Tool Result and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Source consistently requires USB UEFI install and specified cycle sequence. Missing target and expected exceptions are readiness inputs.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Intent is clear; MANUAL ONLY captures core human installation/power actions. Missing project inputs do not create permanent BLOCKED status.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Retains manual/destructive boundary but expands safety and all required cycle evidence.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains its storage, UEFI and event controls while changing classification to MANUAL ONLY because the USB install and AC action are core, not setup only.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates agent evidence, execution status and engineer verdict.

review_improvement: Prevents accidental disk overwrite and prevents a few post-install commands from replacing the physical USB and complete three-mode cycle coverage.
independent_technical_reasoning: Physical USB installation and required AC cycling are central stimuli. They must be engineer-controlled, so the case is MANUAL ONLY even though post-install evidence and some reboot orchestration are automatable.

no_automatic_retry: Do not reinstall, reselect disks, rerun a failed cycle or substitute a different power method automatically.
